publisher_authority.locator: State Cancer Profiles, Incidence Rates Table, Colon & Rectum (Late Stage^), 2019-2023, All Races, Both Sexes, All Ages, by county, stateFIPS=48 and stateFIPS=28
publisher_authority.late_stage_footnote_verbatim: ^ Late Stage is defined as cases determined to be regional or distant. Due to changes in stage coding, Combined Summary Stage with Expanded Regional Codes (2004+) is used for data from Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) databases and Merged Summary Stage is used for data from National Program of Cancer Registries databases. Due to the increased complexity with staging, other staging variables maybe used if necessary.

publisher_authority.reservation_consequence: The third sentence of the late-stage footnote permits the publisher to use other staging variables if necessary. The executed field is therefore not attestable from the publication for either county, and no further page reading can close it.

hinds.documented_default: NPCR Merged Summary Stage; 2018+ leg is the directly assigned Summary Stage 2018, NAACCR item 764

harris.documented_default: SEER CSS-ERC (2004+); 2018+ leg is the Derived Summary Stage 2018, NAACCR item 762

stage_variable.reservation: publisher may use other staging variables if necessary; the executed field is null by design and not by omission
stage_variable.closure_requires: registry extract naming the item used, or a publisher statement that the reservation was not exercised for these cells

resolution.completeness_pivot_source: carried from sprint S807; not re-derived in S809
resolution.ordering_statement: the stage-variable offset binds before the staging-completeness pivot at every admissible pair on the stated grid, so closing the completeness question alone cannot sign this contrast
resolution.ordering_caveat: robust only to a pivot error below 4.5648 Harris cases; the pivot's uncertainty is not quantified in S807's record

share_rate_tolerance_rule.rule: tolerance_pp = k * (100 / min(all_stage_denominators)), with k declared and justified, and tolerance/contrast printed beside every assessment

evaluation_for_this_pair.verdict: only a single-case floor is discriminating in form, and it is defeated by the 2.38 Hinds-case completeness pivot; the pair is RESOLUTION_LIMITED

share_rate_tolerance_rule.withdrawn_basis: 0.5 pp fixed margin justified against 0.1603448276 pp (Hinds) and 0.2052631579 pp (Harris) cited to S525-C2: neither is one case at an integer denominator (623.66 and 487.18 implied denominators) and neither appears in Q04's stored evidence, verdict or correction text

pilot_percentile_in_own_state.estimator: midrank county-count CDF within the state's published-county set: 100 * (counties strictly below + 0.5 * counties tied) / n
pilot_percentile_in_own_state.identifiability_caveat: not identifiable from the published quantiles alone: on the same printed cells a piecewise-linear reading gives harris 62.632794457273, hinds 45.268367031949 and a normal reading from the printed mean and sd gives harris 58.430005636361, hinds 51.399064868624, so the field is only reproducible against the county list, which is not in this record; do not quote it as a published figure
pilot_percentile_in_own_state.added_by: AI review, sprint S841, ledger item Q04 - estimator named after S836 recorded the two fields as unreproduced

within_system_control_distribution.suppression_caveat: counties suppressed at the 16-record floor (75 of 254 in Texas, 7 of 82 in Mississippi) are excluded by construction; the distribution is of counties large enough to publish a percent

records.inference: the near-identity of the two cells is 1/27 of the within-system IQR and cannot be read as evidence of comparable care delivery, comparable constructs or equal system performance; it also cannot be read as evidence of equality, only of indistinguishability at the published grain

follow_up_completion_after_abnormal_test.definition: numerator, individuals with an abnormal screening-indication colorectal test who had a completed diagnostic colonoscopy with pathology documented within 180 days of the abnormal result; denominator, individuals with an abnormal screening-indication colorectal test in the same window; exclusions named in advance; a test ordered does not populate the numerator
